title: 第十九章 消除隐患第二十章 你还有妹妹
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
做完这一切，林枫找了个隐蔽的地方后，便身体进入了空间之中。
猎户的信息，映入眼帘。
是伏虎山附近的猎户。
正是他举报的赵二牛。
两人多次一起进城，但每次进城后，城西牛马市场还没开市，赵二牛便已经将猎物卖完。
卖的快，钱还多，还不给田家武馆交钱，让他嫉妒无比。
便向田家武馆举报了这件事。
记忆中，也只是向田家武馆举报，并没有其他人透露自己举报赵二牛的事情。
确定没有遗漏，林枫才松口气。
善堂目前的工作还是很满意的。
猎户身上除了剔骨刀，还有15两银子，估计是卖猎物的钱。
整理完之后，林枫并未离开空间。
此刻，就算赶回去城门也关了，还容易暴露自己，得不偿失。
今晚打算就在空间里待着。
闲来无事，林枫开始练筋。
早晨已经完成了两组动作，现在是第三组动作。
托举，身子下沉，双手高举，开始拉伸。
起初有些困难，但林枫咬牙坚持了下来。
半个时辰左右，林枫便听到了咯咯的声音，第三组动作也完成了。
似乎太容易了，反倒是林枫开始有些不踏实，怀疑到底突破没有？

毕竟根据田广文、田广元两人的记忆，这一套动作他们练了快两个月才能发出咯咯响声。
这还是有药浴的辅助。
可林枫就半个小时就轻易的完成了，总感觉有些不自信。
难道之前身体排出的杂质浊垢导致的，自己天赋变强了？
越想越觉得有可能，估计是黑莲反馈的能量起了作用。
毕竟，黑莲可是吞噬过野猪、老虎、黑熊。
这些可都比人类猛多了。
加上早晨的两组动作，一天就完成了三组动作。
四组动作为一阶，按照目前的进度，也表示林枫马上就要进入第二阶了。
林枫休息一下，开始第四组动作。
同样，半个时辰就听到了咔咔声，没有任何的难度。
也就是说，黑莲反馈的能量，让他的练武天赋也变高了？
根据赵二豹的记忆，这赵二牛就是天赋异禀的代表。
炼体四层总共才用了一个月不到就完成了。
这就是天才的世界。
前面四组静桩动作完成，身体各大筋已经完成，也标志着林枫正式迈入炼体二层第二个阶段。
第二阶便是：强化阶段（爆发整合）：
通过瞬间的爆发性动作，振荡、锻炼关节筋腱的承受力与传导效率。
content_en:
After doing all this, Lin Feng found a hidden place and entered the space.
Orion's information came into view.
He is a hunter near Fuhu Mountain.
It was Zhao Erniu who he reported.
The two went to the city together many times, but each time they entered the city, Zhao Erniu had already sold out all the prey before the cattle and horse market in the west of the city opened.
He sold it quickly and made a lot of money without paying any money to the Tian Family Martial Arts School, which made him extremely jealous.
He reported this matter to Tianjia Martial Arts School.
In my memory, I only reported to Tianjia Martial Arts School, and no one else revealed that they reported Zhao Erniu.
After confirming that nothing was missing, Lin Feng breathed a sigh of relief.
The current work of Shantang is still very satisfactory.
In addition to the boning knife, the hunter also had 15 taels of silver on him, which was probably money from selling the prey.
After finishing, Lin Feng did not leave the space.
At this moment, even if you rush back and the city gate is closed, you will easily expose yourself, and the gain outweighs the loss.
I plan to stay in the space tonight.
With nothing to do, Lin Feng started to exercise.
Two sets of exercises have been completed in the morning, and now it is the third set.
Lift, lower your body, raise your hands high, and start stretching.
It was difficult at first, but Lin Feng gritted his teeth and persevered.
About half an hour later, Lin Feng heard a gurgling sound, and the third set of movements was completed.
It seemed too easy, but Lin Feng began to feel a little uneasy, wondering if he had achieved a breakthrough?
After all, according to the memories of Tian Guangwen and Tian Guangyuan, they practiced this set of movements for almost two months before they could make a clicking sound.
This is still assisted by medicinal baths.
But Lin Feng finished it easily in half an hour, and he always felt a little unconfident.
Could it be that the impurities and dirt excreted from the body caused it that my talent has become stronger?
The more I think about it, the more possible it becomes. It is probably the energy fed back by Black Lotus that plays a role.
After all, Black Lotus has swallowed wild boars, tigers, and black bears.
These are much more powerful than humans.
Including the two sets of movements in the morning, three sets of movements were completed in one day.
The four sets of movements are the first level. According to the current progress, it also means that Lin Feng will soon enter the second level.
Lin Feng took a rest and started the fourth set of movements.
Similarly, I heard the clicking sound in half an hour without any difficulty.
In other words, the energy fed back by Black Lotus made his martial arts talent higher?
According to Zhao Erbao's memory, this Zhao Erniu is a representative of extraordinary talent.
The four levels of body refining took less than a month to complete.
This is the world of genius.
The first four sets of static pile movements have been completed, and all the major muscles in the body have been completed, which also marks that Lin Feng has officially entered the second stage of the second level of body training.
The second stage is: strengthening stage (explosion integration):
Through instantaneous explosive movements, it oscillates and exercises the endurance and conduction efficiency of joints and tendons.
